reviews.title: just like new
reviews.comment: product looks brand new when i opened it including the packaging. i cant even tell if it was ever used or not. great for the price. i guess i got lucky. the sound is good but i wish the gain nob was designed differently. i move my mic a lot whenever i need table space so i bump the gain a lot which is why theres tape on it.
reviews.author: Ruby Lee

reviews.title: Bang for buck
reviews.comment: Hands down, the best bang-for-your-buck mic! If you use OBS, Streamlabs, or any other broadcasting/recording software, this mic is perfect for you—from beginner to pro. If you know how to set up filters, this mic will take you miles in terms of sound quality and performance.
reviews.author: Rick dickman
